narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Seven parts after the two mark is two plus seven, so nine centimetres.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But this screw ends before the three mark, so it cannot be nine centimetres.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A small part is not a whole centimetre. It is only one tenth of one.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows 2 + 7 = 9 cm; the 3 cm mark flashes; 9 cm is far beyond it; the slip is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To write a length, read the whole centimetres first, and then count the tenths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. A screw ends three parts after the four mark. Write its length.
removed_beats.on_screen: the words whole centimetres first, then tenths appear; a new screw ends 3 parts after the 4 cm mark, with an empty box for its length
